confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Sa Pa's price levels, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than hotel anchors, which vary more with season and property. July is peak season in Sa Pa, so accommodation figures are set toward the higher end of typical ranges. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship: cocktail at about 2.7x beer and wine glass at about 3.3x beer, because direct knowledge of bar and wine prices is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Northern Vietnam hill-station and trekking towns with tourist-facing restaurant and guesthouse markets, benchmarked against budget and mid-range tiers in Hanoi and Ha Giang. Sa Pa restaurant prices are close to Hanoi's tourist-area levels, and its accommodation is priced above Hanoi's budget districts in peak season.
